The '''Battle of ''Organarms''''' was a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Imperial [[Missile Boat]] ''Mu 1'' destroyed the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|X7 Factory]] ''[[Organarms]]''.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of ''Organarms'' first appeared in the first Missile Boat combat training mission, "Dual Warheads," of the [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire|''Defender of the Empire'']] expansion pack of the [[1994]] computer game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']].
